instruction: Pour the liquid from the first violet bottle into the first black bowl, from the second red bottle into the second brown bowl, and from the third turquoise bottle into the third white bowl. Then reset the robot arm.

arguments.note: The violet bottle is centered behind the white bowl. Approach its neck from the front, keeping the jaws clear of the bowls.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: the original plan contains 40 control steps; only its first 20 will execute before the next observation. The remaining steps will not execute automatically. This prefix may end before the target or before a scheduled gripper change; the next observation reports actual execution and target error.

arguments.note: The approach was only partly executed. Continue toward the violet bottle with open jaws.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: the original plan contains 21 control steps; only its first 20 will execute before the next observation. The remaining steps will not execute automatically. arguments.note: The violet neck is centered between the jaws but still ahead of them. Advance toward it while keeping the bottle mouth unobstructed.

arguments.note: The jaws now straddle the violet bottle neck. Close them before lifting.

arguments.note: Forward tilting is limited at this pose. Return upright and move to the near side of the black bowl to pour in the opposite direction.

arguments.note: Continue tipping toward the black bowl until the bottle reaches a pouring orientation.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 18 waypoints (0.7s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The deeper tilt was unreachable at the high near-side pose. Bring the bottle closer over the black bowl and slightly lower while preserving clearance.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 7 waypoints (0.3s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The lower pose has more reach margin. Tip the violet bottle down over the black bowl.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 8 waypoints (0.3s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 11 waypoints (0.4s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: Carry the turquoise bottle to the near side of the white bowl, keeping it upright until the second pour finishes.
